errors.text_span: 具体的刻度标记等距排列
errors.evidence: The description states that the x-axis tick marks are arranged at equal intervals. While they are visually equidistant on the chart, the numerical values they represent (64, 128, 256, 512, 768) are not equally spaced, indicating a non-linear scale. This statement misrepresents the structure of the x-axis.
The description fails to mention the presence of a legend in the top right corner of the plot. Although the legend is empty, it is a visible feature of the chart.
